status: Research only; no account enrollment, VPN configuration, firewall/router change, server build, or device test.
confirmed_request: PC is basically always on and may host family devices away from home.
recommendation: Prototype Tailscale route to existing PC authority; compare Relay if VPN automation conflicts with free signing renewal. Retain local co-op and full offline solo.
critical_distinctions: Remote PC play needs usable internet at both ends.
Enroll each remote game device; do not depend on inheriting the hotspot phone VPN.
Saved private endpoint is separate from local Bonjour discovery.
A disconnected client creates a continuation branch; the PC remains authoritative for players still connected to it.
Published product capabilities do not certify the unbuilt game or these exact devices.
